Over 500 feared dead after refugee boats capsize in Bay of Bengal

More than 500 people are feared dead following reports of two refugee boats capsizing in the Bay of Bengal in recent weeks. Officials are investigating the incidents, which occurred during what is described as a desperate escape. The United Nations has also been cited in relation to the event.
